name: dsh-science
description: Claude Science-style research workbench for DeepSeek Harness: ReAct research-loop engine (research_* tools), multi-project workbench (research_workbench / research_project_* tools + Web panel for classifying & tracking project status), versioned artifacts with provenance (artifact_* tools), SSH remote-compute engine for long bioinformatics jobs on workstations/HPC (remote_* tools), a Biomni-style general-purpose biomedical agent mode (retrieval-augmented planning + code-first execution + reflection: biomni_* tools + preset-biomni), and 11 science skills for genomics / pathogens / bioinformatics. Ships the tiered cross-provider model router via the companion dsh-model-tier bundle.
author: fangchao <fangchao@genomics.cn>

scripts.test: node scripts/smoke-test.mjs && node scripts/biomni-smoke-test.mjs && node packages/dsh-model-tier/test/model-tier.test.mjs && node test/scientific-reviewer.test.mjs && node scripts/validate-presets.mjs
